item.title: Renting vs Buying in 2026: A Practical Decision Guide
item.description:
Quick Answer

Rent when your timeline is uncertain, your cash buffer is thin, or flexibility is worth money to you. Buy when you will stay 5+ years, have a down payment plus a repair fund, and the total monthly cost (mortgage + taxes + insurance + HOA + maintenance) still fits your budget. Compare total monthly costs, never just rent vs mortgage payment.

Renting vs buying is not a debate to win. It is a personal decision about time horizon, cash flow, and how much flexibility you need right now. The best choice is the one that supports your daily life without draining your budget or adding avoidable stress.
